en: Black‑and‑white view over a small lake in a landscaped park. In the foreground and mid‑distance, people are rowing small boats on the water. On a tiny island stands a small pavilion or boathouse with a steep roof. On the far shore is a picturesque lakeside building with two domed corner towers and a veranda or terrace over the water, possibly a restaurant or pavilion. Behind it, on higher ground, rises a large rectangular brick building that looks like a theatre or cultural institution. To the far left, partly separated by trees, a tall, ornate clock‑ or bell‑tower dominates the skyline. The scene is framed by dense trees and appears to be an early‑20th‑century urban park. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image side.
